title: projection: formalize CUE schema and rclone config lifecycle
body: Define the CUE schema, manifest path/config options, credential boundaries, diagnostics, reload atomicity, and self-reference detection. Acceptance: invalid or cyclic configuration fails remote construction without changing upstreams.

title: projection: make List and NewObject share one path conformance matrix
body: Cover root scoping, exact overlays, longest prefixes, synthesized directories, collisions, Unicode, encoding, traversal, and missing upstream objects. Acceptance: listing an object and direct lookup yield the same visible identity and canonical rclone errors.

title: projection: preserve read metadata, hashes, ranges, and open options
body: Delegate object metadata and reads without losing MIME type, hashes, timestamps, size, range/seek semantics, mandatory options, cancellation, or errors. Acceptance: backend conformance tests pass across representative upstream types.

title: projection: add fuzz and fstest integration coverage
body: Add parser/resolver fuzzing and rclone fstest coverage with maintained test remotes. Acceptance: document clean backend unit tests and fstest/test_all results; a local pass is not a hosted CI claim.

title: projection: specify route write ownership and conflict behavior
body: Define which route owns a new path, overwrite behavior, exact-route writes, directory creation, cross-route moves, conflicts, and rollback. Acceptance: approved failure matrix precedes mutation support.

title: projection: implement core write operations
body: Implement Put, Object.Update, Object.Remove, Mkdir, and Rmdir after write ownership is approved. Acceptance: no unsupported write consumes input or changes an upstream; fstest mutation cases pass.

title: projection: negotiate optional rclone backend features
body: Add ListR, Copy, Move, DirMove, Purge, PublicLink, metadata, change notification, shutdown, and usage only when routed upstream capabilities are sound. Acceptance: every advertised feature has positive and fallback tests.

title: projection: validate standard rclone command compatibility
body: Exercise copy, sync, bisync, check, lsjson, mount, filtering, RC, and config flows. Acceptance: compatibility table records command, platform, configuration, result, and remaining limitation.

title: projection: validate rclone serve HTTP and S3 behavior
body: Test serve http and serve s3 over the same projection remote, including ranges, listings, errors, auth, and read-only enforcement. Acceptance: use standard rclone servers; do not add a parallel gateway.

title: projection: specify VFS cache and projected write interaction
body: Document VFS cache modes, retries, visibility, flush, conflicts, crash recovery, and route changes. Acceptance: approved semantics precede any backend write-through or write-back implementation.

title: projection: design embedded manifest discovery and atomic reload
body: Define embedded/adjacent manifest placement, precedence, shadowing, visibility, watches, and atomic reload. Acceptance: deterministic tests cover conflicts and partial failures.

title: projection: write restricted dynamic resolver RFC
body: Compare Lua with restricted alternatives and define CPU, memory, recursion, output, filesystem, network, time/randomness, and observability limits. Acceptance: scripts only emit a validated route resolution and cannot call upstreams.

title: projection: prepare Spaceghost/rclone feature branch integration
body: After the repository route is confirmed, move code to backend/projection, register it in backend/all, add backend docs/data and fstest config, and follow rclone AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING guidance. Acceptance: no public fork changes occur before confirmation.
